children: The Reserve Bank of India conducted dollar-rupee sell-buy swaps for a second straight day on Thursday to drain out rupee liquidity, four traders said, pushing forward premiums sharply higher.
The central bank conducted sell-buy swaps for spot over September and October, the traders said, with one trader saying the operation extended as far out as December.
The 1-year implied rate jumped 18 basis points in response to 3.32%.
